questions.question: Which tool is the industry standard linter used in CI/CD pipelines to enforce CSS code quality and formatting rules?
questions.explanation: Stylelint is the leading modern CSS linter that enforces rules, prevents syntax errors, and standardizes conventions.

questions.question: What is the primary architectural danger of using !important in CSS stylesheets?
options: It overrides natural cascade specificity, making future style maintenance and overrides extremely painful
It only works on desktop Chrome
questions.explanation: !important breaks the natural cascade, creating maintainability nightmares where future modifications also require !important.

questions.question: How many total published topics are included in the complete CodeVerse CSS curriculum?
questions.explanation: The CodeVerse CSS syllabus spans 32 comprehensive topics from foundations to advanced modern architecture.

questions.question: Which pairing of properties should be used for responsive fluid typography without media query breakpoints?
questions.explanation: font-size: clamp(min, preferred, max) continuously scales text smoothly with viewport width without requiring media query jumps.

questions.question: What is the golden rule for choosing between class selectors and ID selectors for styling?
options: Use classes for all styling due to reusability and manageable specificity; reserve IDs for JavaScript and anchor links
questions.hint: Classes for styling, IDs for JS hooks.
questions.explanation: Using classes for styling ensures manageable specificity and reusability, keeping IDs strictly for document hooks.
